senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. יָצָא)to spread, unfold. Denom. יָצוּעַ, יָצִיעַ.
to spread, to prepare the יָצוּעַ, lay out the mattresses &c.; to unfold, to arrange.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 15:3">Sabb. XV, 3</cite> <he>ומַצִּיעִין את המטות וכ׳</he> and one is permitted to rearrange the couches, after being used on the Sabbath night, for use during the Sabbath day.
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:2">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מציעין לו מטה</he> they (the guardians of the poor) procure for him the requirements for a couch.
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:5">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>הִצִּיעָה לו ז׳ וכ׳</he> she arranged for him seven couches.

<cite ref="Gittin 56b">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ס״ת</he> he spread a scroll of the Law (to lie upon it); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite>, end; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 1; a. fr.—Mekh. B’shall., Vayhi, s. 1 <he>ומציעין בהמתם לצאת</he> and putting spreadings upon (saddling) their animals &c.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:12">Tosef. Ber. II, 12</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יַצִּיעַ את המשנה</he> but he must not arrange (lay before them the full text of) the Mishnah; Y. ib. III, 6ᶜ bot.; Bab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a:6">ib. 22ᵃ</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מוּצָע</he>, f. <he>מוּצַעַת</he>. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ bot., v. <cite ref="I00822"><he>טְרִיקְלִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 6:3">Arakh. VI, 3</cite> <he>מטה מו׳</he> a spread couch (supplied with all necessaries). Pesik. Ekhah, p. 122ᵇ <he>ומצאה מוצעת וכ׳</he> and found it (the garment) spread over his couch; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 258">Yalk. Is. 258</cite> <he>ומצאו מוצע</he> (corr. acc.).
